items.title: Aviva fleet collision claims rise 19% from August to November
items.summary: Aviva commercial motor claims data reveals a consistent seasonal rise in collision claims between August and November, prompting calls for winter fleet preparation.

items.title: London brokers embrace AI but fear succession gap, survey finds
items.summary: Research from Burns & Wilcox Global Solutions shows 96% of London brokers view AI positively, even as 92% express concern over replacing retiring Baby Boomers.

items.title: Irwell passes £50 million GWP after 30% growth, opens London office
items.summary: Liability and legal expenses insurer Irwell has grown gross written premium by 30% year on year to pass £50 million, supported by coverholder partnerships and new product lines.
